name: Elf-Blooded Aasimar (Aelfkyn Aasimar Variant)

body:
Aelfkyns are rare but not unheard of in the Material Plane, but are almost as frequently encountered in the Outer Planes where the elven gods make their homes. They look like incredibly beautiful elves, but with the kind of otherworldly, angelic features typical of aasimars—golden skin, gemlike eyes, halos, and so on. They use the height, weight, and age charts for elves instead of those normally used for aasimars.

Aelfkyns are typically Chaotic Good, sharing the same values as their elven cousins. They are generally comfortable around most elves, but may come across as especially aloof to other species, as they tend to always have their attention turned to the overarching cosmic battle between liberty and tyranny, and sometimes lose sight of the mundane day-to-day details.

Core Traits

As an aelfkyn, syou gain the following alternate traits:

Alternate Ability Scores You gain +2 Dex and +2 Cha.
Alternate Skill Modifiers Diplomacy, Perception
Alternate Spell-Like Ability You gain burning gaze as a spell-like ability.
Resistances You gain fire resistance 5, immunity to magic sleep effects, and a +2 species bonus to saving throws against enchantment spells and effects. This trait replaces celestial resistances.
